meta.title: About — Wizard Productions AI Studio
meta.description: Rob Bulkley (Mrwizard94) built WPAI as a one-person studio where AuADHD and ODD are assets, not obstacles. The AI collaboration is in the name — the wizard is in the work.

hero.label: About WPAI
hero.headline: One restless mind. One studio.
hero.subheadline: Built to ship — not to ask permission.

founder.name: Rob Bulkley
founder.intro: I'm Rob Bulkley — Mrwizard94 online. I built Wizard Productions AI Studio because I needed a place where every obsession I have could become a product.
founder.body_1: I'm AuADHD and ODD. I spent years being told those were problems to manage. They're not. Hyperfocus is a superpower when you point it at something real. Pattern recognition across wildly different domains — music theory, compiler behavior, mod loader internals, machine learning epistemology — is exactly what makes WPAI work. The neurodivergence isn't a liability I work around. It's the engine.
founder.body_2: WPAI started as a way to stop letting finished work rot on a hard drive. Every tool I built for myself, every guide I wrote to solve a problem nobody else had documented, every track I finished — it all goes on the storefront. Distribution-first means the work has to be done before it ships. Nothing half-finished.
founder.body_3: The studio runs on three lanes: Music, Software, and Games & Research. Music funds the rest. Software ships now. Games and research build the long-term audience and IP. All three feed each other.

pillars.title: Distribution-first
pillars.body: Finished work goes on sale. Not "eventually" — immediately. If it solves a real problem and it's done, it ships. The storefront is the proof of work.

pillars.title: Neurodivergent as arsenal
pillars.body: AuADHD and ODD aren't obstacles to route around. Hyperfocus, pattern recognition across domains, and an allergy to arbitrary authority are features. WPAI is built on them.

pillars.title: Taste over trend
pillars.body: Heavy music, deep technical writing, and long-horizon research don't chase the algorithm. WPAI makes things that are worth making — and trusts that the right audience finds them.

pillars.title: Nothing ships untouched
pillars.body: Every track, tool, and graphic is directed, finished, and signed off by a human. The studio name is on it. That means something.

ai_statement.headline: AI is in the name. Here's what that means.
ai_statement.body_1: WPAI uses AI tools in production. That's not a footnote — it's in the company name. Every release is made in open collaboration with AI: code generation, lyric drafts, graphic concepts, research synthesis.
ai_statement.body_2: What AI doesn't provide: the ideas, the direction, the taste, the hours, the judgment calls, and the hands-on finish on every release. Those are mine. The AI is a tool. The wizard is the one using it.
ai_statement.body_3: I disclose AI involvement on every release because I think the industry's default of hiding it is dishonest. WPAI's position is the opposite: the collaboration is visible, the human authorship is real, and the work stands on its own.
ai_statement.closing: AI is in the name. The wizard is in the work.
